trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. The checklist only appears after the story, under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, but progress made during the story already counts. It is far more forgiving than true 100% — roughly 60% of the game's content — including any 100 optional missions, scanning 200 of 277 vehicles, studying 100 of 255 animals with binoculars, 300 stunts, any 70 of 80 challenges, all robberies, all 8 bank vaults, all 39 illegal gang operations, all shooting ranges and drone races, and Bret's quests. Nothing on the checklist is missable — everything can be finished in free-roam after the story — so leave this for last and let the other trophies feed it.
trophies.name: A Long Road
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade
PSNProfiles — official name, description and grade; PSN target 0/100
PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide — checklist under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion; ~60% true completion; 100 optional missions; 200/277 vehicles; 100/255 animals; 300 stunts; 70/80 challenges

trophies.guide: Complete any 250 stunts. There are 397 in total across four kinds: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights between buildings and 25 base jumps — mix them however you like, and the under-bridge flights are the quickest to rack up. Track them under Progress > Activities > Stunts, and on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots. Note the 100% checklist wants 300 stunts, so keep going past 250 if you are chasing the Gold.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade

PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide — 397 stunts in 4 categories (130 jumps, 202 under bridges, 40 knife flights, 25 base jumps); 300 needed for 100%

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Strangers & Freaks are the open-world side quests — but only certain strands count: Kirk's Skunk Ape hunt, Kyle's farm jobs, Yago's street racing, Pilot Pete's deliveries, and others still being mapped. The named character questlines (Andy, Billy and the rest) do not count toward it. Watch the trophy tracker in the trophy list for your count. One warning: Yago's 'Race Against Yago' is time-sensitive (hourglass icon), so do his strand when it appears — the guides disagree on whether missing it can actually lock the trophy, so do not leave it. trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 spots at 10 locations, tracked under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. That session disappears once Chapter 1 ends, and it is not yet confirmed whether the trophy needs it, so do it and keep a Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops. trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape the heat. First you need both characters together — possible after Coffee Break in Chapter 2; call your partner with Right on the D-pad + Triangle. Then cause enough chaos to reach 4 stars and break out of the red 'heat' zone (not just the flashing search area). The easy route is a fast sports bike through the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County, where the helicopter cannot follow. It also tends to pop on its own during the big bank vault robberies, which always trigger 4 stars.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Call your partner (Right + Triangle after Coffee Break), then hit 3 robbery targets (green map icons) in a row while the police stay on you — keep the flashing wanted level alive the whole time, never letting it drop. Bring an armored vest, sticky bombs and healing (Zombix/Adrenaline) from Ammu-Nation. A good spot is the 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City, unlocked after Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs: loot a few items in each, crack the back-room safe with sticky bombs, and if the trophy does not pop after the third shop, keep going to a fourth — the unlock is delayed by about half a minute after you leave the last shop.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Aim a firearm and press L3 + R3 to slow time — the purple focus bar drains fast, so make it count: eat, drink or use Adrenaline first to stretch it, wear body armor, and line up 5 enemies at once (gang operation sites are good for this) with a full-auto rifle like the Duke 556. It does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians — use gang members. Focus gets stronger as you level it up (shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing, headshots), so if it feels too short, come back at Focus level 4.

sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade
PSNProfiles — official name, description and grade
PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide — L3 + R3 while aiming; Adrenaline extends it; does not work on soldiers, police or civilians; Focus level 4

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA (Vice City International Airport). Steal one of the large passenger planes docked at a departure terminal — it has to be one connected to a passenger boarding bridge, not one parked on the airfield. The easiest is at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence around the airfield, use the stairs by the boarding bridge to get inside, go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse the plane to the runway and take off. Fly at least 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport before the trophy pops — the unlock is slightly delayed.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade
PSNProfiles — official name, description and grade
PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide — steal a plane docked at a boarding bridge, easiest at terminals E3/E4; fly 1 km away

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. First finish Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs — it unlocks the Snap Gun for silently picking alarmed doors, and marks jewelry store robberies with green icons. Enter through the back door with the Snap Gun (do not kick it — that trips the alarm), find the note with the safe code in the back room, and loot the safe. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good first target.

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Unlock them through the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (wait at the cafe): tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the guard opens the vault, and grab the cash — bring your partner and hand off a bag with Right on the D-pad, since you cannot carry it all. Each vault instantly triggers a 4-star wanted level, so escape on a fast bike and switch cars to go unrecognized. After the mission, pay Yasmani $10,000 for security-van tips (purple markers) to find more vaults. There are 8 large bank jobs in total and the 100% checklist needs all 8, so this pops on the way.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade

PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide — unlocks via That's Where The Money Is…; Yasmani sells van tips for $10,000; 8 bank jobs total

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. The same Chapter 4 mission that unlocks bank vaults (That's Where The Money Is…) counts automatically — tailing the truck to the bank and robbing its vault counts as an armored truck robbery. Or do it earlier: block an armored truck driving near a bank in Vice City, stick a bomb on its back door and blow it open, then escape the red heat radius (a Pay 'n' Spray helps). Sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Rob Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn — one of the gang operations — and steal all 3 key valuables: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun 'Gutterball Moreland 850' on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway (blow it with sticky bombs from Ammu-Nation). The trophy pops after you escape the police, not when you grab the third item. You first visit during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling; if you miss an item, the robbery icon respawns after a while and you can go back for the rest — it is not missable.

trophies.guide: Reach maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Check strength under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > select a character > Strength (heart icon). Work out at fitness clubs (filter the map by Activities, dumbbell icon) or at home after the story — and always train with your partner along (Right + Triangle), because while one character works out the other trains automatically, doubling your progress. You need to be able to switch between both characters, which unlocks after Coffee Break in Chapter 2.

trophies.guide: Make 500 choices that affect your criminal profile. Click the trophy in the trophy list to see your count out of 500. Turn on criminal profile notifications (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile = On) and a small demon face appears on the right of the screen whenever an action counts. Stealthy objectives, clean getaways and destroying evidence push you toward Professional; wounding enemies without killing them is Hardened; killing is Violent; mass killing is Psycho; and excessive violence can leave you permanently Irredeemable — avoid that last one, since the police get far more aggressive. It builds passively through every robbery and fight, so it usually pops on its own near the end.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering marked bills through your contacts. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (meet Raul's crew) to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer. Then rob banks and Payday Loans, and bring the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The $250,000 counts across all deliveries, not in one trip, and bank vaults pay up to $205,000 in a single robbery once they unlock in Chapter 4, so this comes naturally with the other robberies.

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. It counts cumulatively across every shop type — guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest because they cost the most. Ammu-Nation, mod shops, Pay 'n' Sprays, clothing, footwear, hair and beauty salons, tattoo studios and electronics stores all count.

trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Garages go on sale after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver (steal the Crawler for Moses) — you get a notification that the Vice City Real Estate app is on your phone, and you buy through it. The 8 purchasable garages cost $160,000 in total (the 4 story garages do not count). Robberies are the quickest way to earn the cash, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3–4.

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app is installed after the Chapter 2 mission Moses (take a vehicle to Moses), who works out of Port Gellhorn. Buy garages first — each one adds parking spots you need to register more vehicles — then drive stolen cars to Moses, choose Respray and Register in his garage. He only takes vehicles without trackers at first; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registering costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes.
